question: Generate a knowledge-enhanced report for warehouse_safety_0001 using Enterprise RAG context.
ground_truth: Loads vss-generate-video-report-rag for a knowledge-enhanced LVS report. The agent lists available videos when needed, requires a selected video plus scenario/events/optional objects, starts the LVS report through /v1/chat, responds to the actual HITL prompts in config_rag.yml, polls execution status, and presents the completed report with Enterprise RAG context when present.
expected_behavior: Loads vss-generate-video-report-rag for Enterprise RAG or knowledge-enhanced report wording.
Requires a selected video, scenario, events, and optional objects before starting report generation.
Responds only to the actual HITL prompt sequence: scenario, events, objects of interest, and confirmation.
Does not invent a separate Enterprise RAG Query HITL prompt.
Reports failures with execution_id, interaction_id, response_url, or execution status details when available.

question: Enable Enterprise RAG document grounding for LVS reports.
ground_truth: Loads vss-generate-video-report-rag and uses the shipped LVS config_rag.yml through the normal vss-deploy-profile generated.env workflow. It sets VSS_AGENT_CONFIG_FILE to deploy/docker/developer-profiles/dev-profile-lvs/vss-agent/configs/config_rag.yml, includes RAG_SERVER_URL, RAG_API_KEY, and KNOWLEDGE_COLLECTION as needed, and avoids stale app/video_search_frag or deployments/developer-workflow paths.
expected_behavior: Uses generated.env rather than mutating the checked-in .env.
Documents RAG_SERVER_URL, RAG_API_KEY, and KNOWLEDGE_COLLECTION for frag_retrieval.
Does not print plaintext API tokens.
